description: Multi-chain EVM wallet portfolio lookup: native coin plus curated token balances with best-effort USD valuation for one address across Base, Ethereum and BSC, read live from public RPC with prices from DexScreener. Optional chains parameter selects a subset (default: all three). USD values are estimates and may be null for illiquid tokens; per-chain failures are reported per chain instead of failing the whole call.
name: wallet-lookup-pro
